title: epipactis palustris f. robusta
intro: Epipactis palustris f. robusta, commonly known as Marsh Helleborine, is a subspecies of orchid native to Europe and Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Epipactis palustris f. robusta include its ability to reduce inflammation, act as an antiseptic, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its potential in treating various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
